book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.title: Book of Occult Arts
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.author: Seleris, the Chronicler of the Veil
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.02: These pages gather what I have learned among the three factions. Times, prices and rewards follow the usual rules, but may differ from one world to another. Watch the villagers and listen to their words.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.03: Villagers can become Vampires, Hunters, or Werewolves. Even after transforming, they remain the same people, but their new nature changes their choices and alliances.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.04: Look for red eyes, pale skin, greater agility, and fear of sunlight. In addition, every transformed villager receives the Vampire trait.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.05: A Hunter villager usually protects other Hunters and distrusts Vampires and Werewolves. When threatened, they often use a pitchfork, and their blood contains a high concentration of garlic.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.06: Ears and claws can reveal a Werewolf. They are not very difficult to recognize once you find one. Transformed villagers receive the Werewolf trait.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.07: Vampires can drink the blood of human villagers. Villagers who are already Vampires cannot be used as a source of blood.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.08: Some bites can spread the vampire disease. Transformation takes time. Children normally cannot be bitten or infected, but they can still inherit their parents' nature.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.09: Be careful when trying to drink a Hunter's blood. It is harmful to Vampires and can cause negative effects.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.10: Before the transformation finishes, the disease can still be stopped. Give the infected villager a bucket of milk. If left untreated, they will become a Vampire.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.11: When the transformation ends, the villager gains some of a Vampire's powers and habits. Returning them to humanity requires the cure.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.12: Vampires rest by day and work at night. They seek their bed or a shaded place. A roof, head covering, water or rain can shield them from sunlight. Following someone or fighting may draw them out of shelter.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.13: Werewolf attacks can spread lycanthropy. Transformation may take some time. Children normally cannot be bitten, but they can still inherit their parents' nature.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.14: Vampires, Hunters, and Werewolves do not always live together peacefully. They may refuse conversations, protect allies, or attack enemies. Guards may also defend villagers tied to the village faction.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.15: To cure a Vampire or Werewolf villager, give them an extended Potion of Weakness, a golden apple and a garlic injection. Use the items on them or offer them as gifts, in any order.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.16: Use a Potion of Weakness lasting at least four minutes. Give all three ingredients within five minutes. Then wait about three minutes for the cure to finish.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.17: Happy particles show that the cure has begun. During this period, the villager is weak and cannot fight or trade. Keep them somewhere safe and do not place them inside a block.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.18: Vampire villagers usually offer better prices to other Vampires. Humans may pay more, while Hunters and Werewolves may be refused.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.19: Hunters receive discounts when trading with Hunter villagers. Revealed Vampires and transformed Werewolves may be refused.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.20: Werewolf villagers favor other members of their own pack. Vampires and Hunters may pay more or be unable to trade. Humans are usually still accepted.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.21: A disguised Vampire may be treated as human. If their true nature is discovered during a trade, the villager may raise the price or end the trade.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.22: Factions influence trust. Gifts and conversations are still important, but enemies receive penalties and may reject flirting, kisses, or other more intimate advances.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.23: Some rivals may refuse marriage proposals. Special villagers may also refuse to follow an enemy's orders. Allies still respond to commands such as follow and stay.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.24: When only one parent is a Vampire or Werewolf, the baby has a good chance of inheriting that nature. When both parents belong to the same kind, the baby normally does as well.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.25: The child of a Vampire and a Werewolf may inherit either nature, but never both at the same time.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.26: Totems can place a village under Vampire, Hunter, or Werewolf control. Each kind of village grants benefits to members of its own faction.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.27: A Vampire village grants benefits to Vampires. A Hunter village can cure infections and gain new allies. Werewolves usually resist changes that try to remove their nature.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.28: Storing a villager in Easy Villagers preserves their appearance and faction. The Trader keeps discounts and refusals. Enemies may be unable to capture them; while healing, nobody can store them.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.29: The Inspiration Altar, Research Table and Stone Altar give Vampires, Hunters and Werewolves their trades. They work in the village and the Trader. A villager must belong to the right faction to take the job.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.30: The Breeder and Incubator preserve family ties and the nature inherited by babies. If either parent is infertile, the Breeder produces no child and uses no food. Check its message before trying again.

book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.31: In villages with an active totem, adults of the ruling faction may ask humans and allies for help. Ask: “Need any help?”. Being a Vampire in an ordinary village is not enough to offer a favor.

book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.32: Listen to the request and accept if you can help. To deliver, hold the requested item and offer it as a gift to the same person. Carry the full amount in your inventory; they will take only what you agreed on.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.33: Sometimes an infection cannot wait. If someone asks for milk, accept the favor and use a milk bucket to treat them. This only helps before the transformation is complete; afterwards, they will need the cure.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.34: Simple favors usually earn 3 hearts; special requests, 5; urgent help and supplies after attacks, 8. Check the reward before accepting. The agreed amount stays written in the journal and does not change afterwards.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.35: After an enemy attack, villagers may need supplies: 4 full blood bottles for Vampires, 8 loaves of bread for Hunters or 8 raw mutton for Werewolves. These requests appear during the first day after the fight.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.36: Those with a faction trade may ask for materials: the Vampire specialist needs 2 fangs; the Hunter, 4 iron ingots; the Werewolf, 4 bones. If the village has an urgent need, that takes priority.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.37: The upper bookmark opens this guide; the lower one opens the mission journal. It holds accepted favors, with the person, place, reward and time left. Lending the book does not pass your promises to someone else.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.38: Use the arrows to choose a favor in the journal and “Track” to highlight the person who asked. Scroll to read longer entries. To discuss the request or give it up, return to the same person and ask about the favor.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.39: The deadline starts when you accept: usually two days in the world. If the world keeps running while you are away, time still passes. Check the journal. Take care of one favor at a time in each village.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.40: A villager being out of sight does not end their request. Their death, a lost totem or hostile rule may end it. After finishing, declining or giving up a favor, wait a while before seeking another in that village.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.41: Some worlds let family ties and friendship prevent attacks caused by rivalry. This rule is off by default. When used, it still allows self-defense after an attack. Affection does not remove faction trade refusals.
book.mca_vamp_compat.occult_arts.page.42: In newer MCA × EV versions, hover over a block’s indicator to learn why it stopped. The villager item shows their profession and age. Hold Shift to read more about infertility, faction and healing.
